findings.evidenceJa: 血がぜんっぜん足りない
findings.governingReading: 血がぜんっぜん足りない identifies a deficit of blood in the drained victim.
findings.explanation: Insufficient blood becomes insufficient blood flow.

findings.highlight: it isn't the first time I've seen
findings.evidenceJa: つい最近、すごく間近で見た覚え
findings.governingReading: つい最近、すごく間近 says he vaguely remembers seeing this intensely serious face very recently and at very close range.
findings.explanation: The tentative remembered face loses both its recency and closeness.

findings.highlight: my other hand is partially severed from the rest of me.
findings.governingReading: 引きちぎれそうな腕 is his threatened or near-tearing arm after the forearm penetration.
findings.explanation: An arm that feels as though it may be torn off becomes a hand already partially severed.

findings.governingReading: 腐葉土 names decomposed-leaf soil in the grove.

findings.highlight: my mind is now blank from wanting to believe
findings.evidenceJa: 思いこみたくなるぐらい、真っ白だった
findings.governingReading: 思いこみたくなるぐらい、真っ白だった makes the wish to believe this is a post-death dream a measure/result of his terrifying blankness.
findings.explanation: A mind so blank that he wants to believe he is dreaming becomes a mind blank because he wants that belief.

findings.highlight: There's no way that coincidence is lining up this much...
findings.evidenceJa: 決して偶然などでは防げない
findings.governingReading: The paragraph moves from how often chance can continue to the stronger problem that even the first undodgeable head attack could never be blocked by chance.
findings.explanation: The first impossible block’s failure of a chance explanation becomes improbability of repeated coincidences.

findings.evidenceJa: ぞっとするほど綺麗だった
findings.governingReading: Rider's irritated voice is simultaneously beautiful enough to send a shiver through Shirou.
findings.explanation: Rider's voice changes from chillingly beautiful to surprisingly beautiful and sensual. Attraction remains, but its expressly unsettling quality is weakened.
